purpose: Faithful multi-commit snapshot of current production source variants; no db_locking convergence or bulk service restart.

persistent_state.rule: No database, lock, queue, log, credential, provider, WAL, timeout, or persistent-state authority is relocated by source staging. Each service's path parity must pass before its cutover.

main_workers.source_snapshot_method: Current main src/**/*.py tree copied byte-for-byte into a clean commit; databases, logs, docs and dirty development checkout were not moved.

recovery_workers.source_snapshot_method: Current recovery src/**/*.py tree copied byte-for-byte into a clean commit; two modified tracked modules are now committed.

qualification_so_far.source_tree_exactness: PASS for staged main and recovery Python source trees; API and listener remain on their previously qualified source commits.
qualification_so_far.main_worker_offline_tests: 19 relevant focused tests passed; one stale trigger-assumption test failed and one live-DB fixture test failed in isolated checkout. Both are explicitly excluded from a deployment verdict pending review.
qualification_so_far.recovery_worker_offline_tests: 16 relevant focused tests passed; one stale checkpoint-location assertion failed and is explicitly excluded from a deployment verdict pending review.
qualification_so_far.source_and_checkout_remote_reachability: PASS for all four source commits at their pinned remote refs.
qualification_so_far.full_state_path_parity: HOLD: scheduler needs explicit OPS_V2_DB_PATH, FLEX_DB_PATH and OPS_SCHEDULER_LOCK; Cascade's two trace/snapshot log modules still derive source-local paths. Other pending services require independent path checks.
qualification_so_far.functional_live_cutovers: NOT_STARTED for seven pending application services.

hard_gates: Do not promote rc1 to active v1 until every running application PID uses its pinned SHA and its loaded source identity is verified after restart.
No service follows a mutable branch or HEAD; production source checkouts are detached at explicit commit SHAs.
No db_locking variant is reconciled or replaced in this release.
Before each service-only change: verify exact source/config preimages, persistent-state paths, rollback source SHA and current unrelated PIDs.

After each service-only change: verify natural useful work, source identity, persistent-state parity, error-free operation and unrelated PID stability; rollback only that service on a bounded abort criterion.
Keep dirty development checkout untouched and never bulk-restart its services.
next_action: Qualify state-path and loaded-source gates for one pending service at a time. Do not treat this staged rc1 manifest as an active production release.
